description: You need a Scale Dealer or Repairer license to trade, sell, receive or repair used weighing or measuring devices. The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) gives this license.

title: Scrap Metal Processor License
description: You need a Scrap Metal Processor license to run a business that buys, processes and ships scrap metal. This includes both ferrous and non-ferrous scrap. The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) issues this license.

title: Secondhand Dealer Auto License
description: A Secondhand Dealer Auto license is required to buy or sell secondhand automobiles. The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) issues this license.

title: Secondhand Dealer General License
description: If you buy or sell used goods in New York City, you need a Secondhand Dealer General license. This does not include cars. The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) gives out this license.

title: Sightseeing Bus License
description: The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) issues a license for sightseeing buses. You need this license to drive a bus with eight or more paying passengers. This includes trips to places of interest or amusement or special trips starting in New York City.

title: Slaughterhouse License - Poultry/Small Animals
description: If you sell domestic animals or birds, you need a Slaughterhouse License from the New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets.

title: Small Arms Firing Range Designation
description: If you want to run a small arms firing range in New York City, you need a Small Arms Firing Range Permit. The New York City Police Department gives out these permits.

title: Stoop Line Stand License
description: You need a Stoop Line Stand license to sell fruits, vegetables, soft drinks, flowers, candy or ice cream from a stand outside and next to your store. The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) issues this license.

title: Storage Warehouse License
description: You need a Storage Warehouse License if your business stores people's household goods for a fee. You need a separate license for each place that your stores these goods. Self-storage businesses do not need this license. The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) gives out this license.

title: Summer, Day, Overnight, Traveling or Municipal Camps for Children
description: You must send new permit and renewal applications to the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene. Do this at least 90 days before the camp opens.

title: Tavern Wine License
description: This license lets you sell wine and beer for people to drink at your place. You cannot sell liquor with this license. Your place must not be a full restaurant with a full kitchen. The New York State Liquor Authority (SLA) gives this license.

title: Taxi Meter Shop License
description: You need a Taxi Meter Shop Business License if your company works with taxi meters for New York City Medallion Cabs.

title: Taxicab License Transfer Tax
description: If you sell a taxicab license, the buyer must pay the transfer tax. If the buyer does not pay, the seller must pay the tax.

title: Temporary Amusement Rides
description: The City inspects and licenses amusement rides at street fairs, block parties and special events. This is to ensure the safety of operators and riders. All amusement rides must pass a check by the Department of Buildings (DOB) before use. Examples of rides are:

title: Ticket Reseller Branch Office, License to Operate a
description: Ticket resellers need a license to run branch offices. This license comes from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Ticket Reseller License
description: Businesses that resell tickets, people who resell tickets, and websites that resell tickets need a license from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Ticket Seller Business License
description: You need a Ticket Seller Business license to sell, give or transfer any ticket to a person or company for them to sell in a public space. The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) gives out this license.

title: Tissue Bank Operation License
description: Facilities need a Tissue Bank Operating License to test, preserve or handle human tissue. This license is from the Wadsworth Center at the New York State Department of Health.

title: Tobacco Retail Dealer License
description: The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) offers a license for tobacco retail dealers. You need this license to sell cigarettes or tobacco products to people.

title: Tow Truck Company License
description: You need a Tow Truck Company License if your business moves or removes disabled cars, illegally parked cars, abandoned cars or cars in accidents. The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) issues this license.

title: Trade Association Application
description: You need a Trade Association Registration to work in a New York City public wholesale market. This group should help manage or promote the market or businesses in the market.

title: Warehouse (Food) License
description: You need a Warehouse (Food) License to store food for commercial distribution. The New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets gives this license.

title: Warehouse/Locker Plant (Refrigerated) License
description: If you rent cold storage space for food, you need a license. This license is from the New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets.

title: Watch, Guard, or Patrol Agency License
description: If you want to run a security service business in New York, you need a license. This includes watch, guard and patrol agencies. The New York State Department of State (NYSDOS) gives out these licenses. You can get a license as a person or for your business.

title: Wholesale Cigarette Dealer Other Than Those Who Only Operate Vending Machines License
description: You need this license to sell cigarettes and tobacco products in bulk. The New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (DTF) gives out this license.

title: Wholesale Cigarette Dealer Who Only Operates Vending Machines License
description: You need this license if you sell cigarettes and tobacco products to vending machine operators. The New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (DTF) gives out this license. One license covers all of your business locations.

title: Wholesale Cigarette License
description: The City Finance Department gives licenses to wholesale cigarette dealers. There are three types of dealers:

title: Wine Store License
description: This license lets businesses sell wine to take home. It does not cover liquor or beer. The New York State Liquor Authority (SLA) gives this license.

title: Acupuncture Professional License
description: If you want to do acupuncture in New York, you need a license from the New York State Education Department (NYSED).

title: Apartment Sharing Agent
description: If you help people find roommates, you need a license from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Architect License
description: Architects need a license from the New York State Education Department (NYSED). The license requirements depend on your education and your supervised architectural work experience.

title: Asbestos Handling License
description: Businesses that work with asbestos need a license from the New York State Department of Labor.

title: Attorney/Legal Information
description: To be an attorney in New York State, you must pass the Bar Exam. You need to have completed at least some formal legal studies to take the Bar Exam.

title: Audiologist Professional License
description: Audiologists and speech-language pathologists need licenses from the New York State Education Department (NYSED).

title: Bail Bond Agent License
description: You need a Bail Bond Agent License to write bail bonds for an insurer. The New York State Department of Financial Services (DFS) gives this license.

title: Barber (Master) License
description: A Master Barber License lets you work as a barber. This license is from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Barber Apprentice License
description: A Barber Apprentice License lets you work and train with a licensed barber. The New York State Department of State (NYSDOS) gives this license.

title: Bingo Game Operator License
description: The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) offers a license for bingo game operators. This license is needed for any nonprofit group that wants to run bingo games. For-profit groups cannot get this license. Bingo games involve matching numbers or symbols on a card with those chosen at random. Winners get prizes.

title: Budget Planner's License
description: In New York State, budget planners need a license from the New York State (NYS) Department of Financial Services (DFS). Budget planners help people pay off their debt by making contracts with clients.

title: Certified Public Accountancy Professional License
description: Accountants, including Certified Public Accountants (CPAs), must be licensed to practice in New York State. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) gives out these licenses. You need this license to call yourself a CPA.

title: Class A Photo Identification
description: You need a Class A Photo Identification card to work at the New Fulton Fish Market. These cards do not expire.

title: Class B Photo Identification
description: You need a Class B Photo Identification card to work at the New Fulton Fish Market or other markets that the Business Integrity Commission regulates. These cards do not expire.

title: Clinical Laboratory Technician Professional License
description: To work as a clinical laboratory technician in New York State, you need a license from the New York State Education Department (NYSED).

title: Clinical Laboratory Technologist Professional License
description: To work in a clinical lab in New York State, you need a license from the New York State Education Department (NYSED). This license lets you test blood and body fluids.

title: Commercial Driver License
description: In New York State, you need a Commercial Driver License (CDL) to drive a truck or other commercial vehicle. The New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) issues the CDL. Before you can apply for a CDL, you must have a regular driver's license.

title: Commercial Driver License - "S" School Bus Endorsement
description: If you have a New York State Commercial Driver License (CDL), you need an "S" (school bus) endorsement to drive school buses.

title: Commercial Driver License - Bus Driver Part 19-A Application
description: If you have a Commercial Driver License (CDL) and want to drive a bus, you need to apply for a Bus Driver License under Article 19-A. This rule does not apply to school bus drivers.

title: Commercial Driver License - Metal Coil Endorsement
description: Commercial drivers in New York State need a Metal Coil Endorsement to transport metal coils. The endorsement is needed if the weight of a single coil is 5000 lbs or more, or if more than one coil weighs 5000 lbs or more when bundled together.

title: Commuter Van Driver License
description: A commuter van driver gets a license from the Taxi and Limousine Commission (TLC). The driver can carry passengers for money. The van must have seats for at least 9 but not more than 20 passengers.

title: Cosmetology License
description: People who do nails, hair, waxing and beauty treatments need a cosmetology license from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Cytotechnologist Professional License
description: You need a license to work as a cytotechnologist in New York State. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) issues this license.

title: Dental Anesthesia / Sedation
description: Dentists need a certificate from the New York State Education Department (NYSED) to use anesthesia.

title: Dental Assistant Professional License
description: Dental assistants need a license from the New York State Education Department (NYSED) to work in New York State. Assistants must be supervised by a licensed dentist.

title: Dental Hygienist Professional License
description: Dental hygienists need a license from the New York State Education Department (NYSED) to work in New York State. Hygienists must be supervised by a licensed dentist.

title: Dentist Professional License
description: Dentists need a Dentist Professional License to work in New York State. This license comes from the New York State Education Department (NYSED).

title: Dietician / Nutritionist Professional License
description: You need a license to work as a dietician or nutritionist in New York State. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) issues these licenses. You must meet certain education and experience requirements to get the license.

title: Electrician License
description: To do electrical work in New York City, you need a license from the Department of Buildings. There are two types of licenses:

title: Emergency Medical Technician-Basic
description: You can become a Basic Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) in New York State. The New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH) gives this certification.

title: Emergency Medical Technician-Critical Care
description: If you are an EMT with a Basic certification, you can get a Critical Care certification. This certification is from the New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH).

title: Emergency Medical Technician-Intermediate
description: If you are an EMT with a Basic certification, you can get an Intermediate certification. This certification is from the New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH).

title: Emergency Medical Technician-Paramedic
description: The New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH) offers a Paramedic certificate, also called the Advanced Emergency Medical Technician (AEMT-P) certificate. It is the highest level of certification for pre-hospital emergency care.

title: Esthetics License
description: If you want to perform beauty treatments, you need an Esthetics License from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Euthanize Animals, Certification as a Technician to
description: This permit lets you get materials for euthanizing an animal. The substance must come from a registered facility and its agent.

title: Excess Line Broker License (Individual)
description: You need this license to get insurance from companies not licensed in New York State. You must pay fees to the State, with the amount of fees depending on where you live.

title: Funeral Director, Embalmer, and Undertaker Licensing Requirements
description: Funeral directors, embalmers and undertakers need licenses. These licenses come from the New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH).

title: General Contractor
description: If you are a general contractor who supervises construction work or demolition, you need to register with the New York City Department of Buildings (DOB).

title: Guide License
description: If you want to be a wilderness guide, you need a Guide License. The New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) issues this license.

title: Hearing Aid Dispenser
description: Businesses that provide hearing aids must register with the New York State Department of State. Licensed audiologists alone do not meet this rule. A separate registration is needed to sell hearing aids. Businesses need both registrations.

title: High Pressure Boiler Operating Engineer License
description: You need a High Pressure Boiler Operating Engineer License to run high-pressure boilers in New York City. This license is for both stationary and portable boilers. For more details, contact the Department of Buildings.

title: Hoisting Machine Operator License
description: You need a Hoisting Machine Operator License to use a crane or other hoisting machine in New York City. The Department of Buildings gives out this license.

title: Horse Drawn Cab Driver License
description: The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) offers a license for horse-drawn cabs. You need this license to drive a horse-drawn cab in New York City.

title: Inspector Certification
description: You need an Inspector Certificate to inspect motor vehicles. The New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) gives this certificate.

title: Landscape Architect License
description: If you want to work as a landscape architect in New York State, you need a license. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) issues this license.

title: Locksmith Apprentice License
description: You need a Locksmith Apprentice License to learn the trade of locksmithing. You must work under a licensed locksmith. The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) gives this license. You must be employed by a DCWP-licensed locksmith to apply.

title: Locksmith License
description: You need a Locksmith License to fix, service, install, check and open and close locks. The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) gives this license.

title: Massage Therapy License
description: To work as a massage therapist, masseur or masseuse in New York State, you need a Massage Therapy License. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) gives this license.

title: Master Fire Suppression Piping Contractor License
description: You need a Master Fire Suppression Piping Contractor License (Class A, B and C) to work on fire suppression-related plumbing in New York City. This includes:

title: Master Plumber License
description: A master plumber can perform or oversee plumbing work in New York City. The Department of Buildings (DOB) gives this license.

title: Medallion Agent
description: A TLC licensed agent helps run a taxicab. They can work for one or more owners. They can be employees or work through contracts.

title: Medallion Owner, Individual
description: Medallion owners have a special license. This license lets you own a car that the Taxi and Limousine Commission (TLC) approves for use as a taxi. A medallion taxi is the only car that can pick up people who hail them on the street, anywhere in the City. The number of medallions in the City is limited by State law. However, you can transfer a medallion by law and resell it.

title: Medical Physics Professional License
description: Medical physicists need a license to work in New York State. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) gives out this license.

title: Medical Specialist Assistant Professional License
description: Medical specialist assistants help doctors. In New York State, you need a license to be a medical specialist assistant. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) issues these licenses.

title: Mental Health Practitioner Professional License
description: In New York State, mental health counselors need a license from the New York State Education Department (NYSED).

title: Midwifery Professional License
description: Midwives need a license from the New York State Education Department (NYSED).

title: Mortgage Banker License
description: You need this license to make mortgage loans in New York State and act as a mortgage banker. It is for anyone who makes three or more mortgage loans in a year.

title: Mortgage Guaranty Insurance Agent License
description: In New York State, you need a license to be a mortgage guaranty insurance agent. There are different licenses for companies and people.

title: Mutual Life Insurer License
description: You need a license to sell mutual life insurance in New York State. Separate licenses are needed if your business is based inside and outside New York State.

title: Nail Specialty License
description: A Nail Specialty License lets you work on nail appearance. You get this license from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Natural Hair Styling License
description: If you want to style hair, you need a license from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS). This license is for people, not businesses. Businesses need a different license.

title: Notary Public Commission
description: To be a notary in New York State, you need a license from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Nurse Practitioner
description: A nurse practitioner is a Registered Nurse with special certification from the New York State Department of Education.

title: Nurse Registered Professional (RN) License
description: To be a Registered Nurse (RN) in New York, you must register with the New York State Education Department.

title: Nurse, Licensed Practical (LPN)
description: Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs) help care for patients. They work under a Registered Nurse or a doctor. To be an LPN in New York State, you need a license. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) gives this license.

title: Nursing Home Administrator, License to Practice
description: You need a Nursing Home Administrator License to run a nursing home. This license is from the New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH).

title: Nursing Home Nurse Aide Certification
description: Nurses need a certificate to work in a nursing home. This certificate comes from the New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH).

title: Oil-Burning Equipment Installer License
description: You need an Oil-Burning Equipment Installer License (Class A and B) to get a construction permit for oil-burning equipment installation or to perform such work in New York City. Contact the Department of Buildings for more information.

title: Ophthalmic Dispensing Professional License
description: To get this license, you need to meet certain educational, experience and exam requirements. If you are waiting to take the exam, you can get a limited permit. This permit lets you work under a licensed doctor, optometrist or optician.

title: Optometry Professional License
description: To get this license, you need to meet various requirements. You must have a four-year Doctor of Optometry degree. If you have a license from another state, you can transfer it to New York.

title: Paratransit Car Driver License
description: You need a Paratransit Driver's License to drive a Paratransit car. These cars help people in wheelchairs get around New York City.

title: Pedicab Driver License
description: The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) offers a license for pedicab drivers.

title: Pharmacist Professional License
description: Pharmacists in New York need a license from the New York State Education Department (NYSED).

title: Physical Therapist Professional License
description: Physical therapists need a license to work in New York State. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) gives this license.

title: Physician / Doctor Professional License
description: To work as a doctor in New York, you need a license from the New York State Education Department (NYSED).

title: Podiatrist Professional License
description: Podiatrists need a license to work in New York State. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) gives this license.

title: Press Credential
description: The Press Credentials Office (PCO) of the Mayor's Office of Media and Entertainment gives out press credentials, or press cards.

title: Private Investigator's License
description: Private investigators need a license in New York State. The New York State Department of State (NYSDOS) gives this license.

title: Private School Director License
description: You need a license to be a director of a private school. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) gives this license.

title: Private School License
description: Private schools for adults need a license. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) gives this license.

title: Private School Teacher License or Permit
description: To teach in a private school in New York, you need a license. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) gives out these licenses.

title: Process Server Individual License
description: You need a Process Server Individual License if you serve, personally or by substitute service, five or more legal papers in a year. The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) gives this license.

title: Psychoanalyst Professional License
description: Psychoanalysts need a license from the New York State Education Department (NYSED). This license lets you work as a psychoanalyst in New York State.

title: Psychologist Professional License
description: Psychologists need a license from the New York State Education Department (NYSED). This license lets you work as a psychologist in New York State.

title: Radiologic Technologist License
description: To use radiologic technology on people, you need a Radiologic Technologist License. This license comes from the New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH).

title: Real Estate Appraiser
description: Real estate appraisers in New York State need licenses. These licenses come from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Real Estate Broker Associate License
description: This license lets a real estate broker work under another broker. New York accepts broker licenses from other states.

title: Real Estate Broker License
description: Real estate brokers need a license to work in New York State. This license comes from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Real Estate Salesperson License
description: People who sell real estate in New York need a license. The New York State Department of State (NYSDOS) gives this license.

title: Respiratory Therapist Professional License
description: You need a license to work as a respiratory therapist in New York State. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) gives this license.

title: Respiratory Therapy Technician Professional License
description: You need a license to work as a respiratory therapy technician in New York State. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) gives this license.

title: Rigger License
description: You need a Rigger License to hoist or lower any item on the outside of a building in New York City. The Department of Buildings issues this license.

title: Security or Fire Alarm Systems, License to Install, Service or Maintain
description: You need a license to install or maintain security or fire alarm systems. This license comes from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Sightseeing Guide License
description: You need a Sightseeing Guide license to guide or direct people to any place or point of interest or to describe, explain or lecture about any such place to any person in connection with a sightseeing trip or tour within the City.

title: Sign Hanger License
description: You need a Sign Hanger License to get a construction permit or to hang or attach signs in New York City. There are two types of licenses:

title: Tattoo Artist License - Temporary
description: If you want to work as a tattoo artist in New York City for up to seven days, you need a Temporary Tattoo Artist License. You must work under someone with a valid full-term Tattoo Artist License from the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH).

title: Tattoo License
description: You need a Tattoo License to work as a Tattoo Artist in New York City. This license helps stop the spread of diseases.

title: Ticket Seller Individual License
description: You need a Ticket Seller license if you sell tickets in a public space. This includes selling, giving or transferring tickets to another person for sale in a public space. The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) issues this license.

title: TLC Driver License
description: The TLC Driver License lets you drive a taxi or for-hire vehicle. This includes:

title: Tow Truck Driver License
description: You need a Tow Truck Driver License to move or remove cars. This includes cars that are disabled, parked illegally, abandoned or in accidents. You need this license if you do this work for money in New York City. The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) gives out this license.

title: Veterinary Medicine Professional License
description: Veterinarians need a license to work in New York State. The New York State Education Department (NYSED) gives this license.

title: Waxing License
description: You need a license to offer wax or hair removal services. This license comes from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Welder License
description: You need a Welder License to do structural welding in New York City. The Department of Buildings issues this license.

title: Wholesale Tobacco Products Dealer License
description: You need this license if you sell tobacco products other than cigarettes. The New York State Department of Taxation and Finance gives out this license. You also need this license if you run vending machines for tobacco products.

title: Working (Rental) Horse License
description: All working horses need a license from the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene's Office of Veterinary Public Health Services (VPHS).

title: Adding Chemicals to Water Supply - Permit
description: You need this permit for your business to chemically treat the drinking water supply within a building. This permit lets you add chemicals only for:

title: Air Permits
description: Businesses in New York City may need an Air Permit issued by the Department of Environmental Protection (DEP). You need this permit if you use equipment or do activities that the New York City Air Pollution Control Code (Air Code) regulates.

title: Air Pollution Control - State Facility Permit
description: Businesses that release pollutants into the air need permits from the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC). If your facility emits pollutants at certain levels, you must get a State Facility Permit.

title: Air Pollution Control - Title V Facility Permit
description: Businesses that release pollutants into the air need permits from the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC). If your business emits pollutants at high levels, you need a Title V Permit.

title: Alcoholic Beverage Transportation Permit
description: If your business moves alcoholic drinks in, to or from New York State, you need a permit from the New York State Liquor Authority (SLA). The type of permit you need depends on how you move the alcohol and how long you need the permit.

title: Apartment Information Vendor Permit
description: If you give information about apartment rentals, you need a license. This license comes from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Armored Car Carrier Permit
description: Businesses that use armored cars for hire need a permit from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Armored Car Guard Permit
description: If you work as an armed guard for an armored car business, you need to register with the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Bail Enforcement Agent Permit (Bounty Hunter)
description: Bail enforcement agents, also called bounty hunters, need a license from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Barber Shop Permit
description: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) gives Barber Shop Permits. This permit lets you run a barber shop in New York City. Barbers cut hair and trim or shave mustaches and beards. The shop owner must file the application.

title: Building Water Tank Cleaning, Painting and Coating Permit
description: You need this permit to clean, paint or coat water tanks in buildings. These tanks hold drinking water.

title: Campground or Travel Trailer Park, Permit to Operate
description: You need a permit to run a campground or travel trailer park in New York State. The New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH) issues this permit.

title: Canopy Permit
description: You need a permit from the Department of Transportation (DOT) to install or maintain a canopy on a sidewalk at the entrance to a building or business. A licensed professional must install the canopies. Before installation, you must get approval from the NYCDOT Highway Inspection Quality Assurance Unit.

title: Caterer's Alcohol Permit
description: If you cater events at places without a liquor license, you need a Caterer's Alcohol Permit to serve alcoholic beverages. This permit is for one event only. The New York State Liquor Authority (SLA) issues this permit.

title: Clinical Laboratory and/or Blood Bank Permit
description: In New York State, clinical labs and blood banks need permits. The Wadsworth Center at the New York State (NYS) Department of Health gives these permits.

title: Construction Permits
description: The Department of Buildings reviews construction plans. They make sure the plans follow the Building Code and meet current safety and zoning requirements. After the plans are approved, a contractor may apply for a construction work permit.

title: Crocodilian Permit
description: If you sell products made from alligators, crocodiles or similar animals, you need a Crocodilian Permit from the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC).

title: Daily Over-Dimensional Permit
description: If your vehicle is too big or heavy, you need a Daily Over Dimensional Permit to drive in New York City.

title: Divisible Load Overweight Permit
description: Vehicles that are too heavy for New York State roads need a permit from the New York State Department of Transportation (NYSDOT).

title: Domestic Animal Health Permit
description: Businesses that buy, deal or sell domestic animals need a Domestic Animal Health Permit. The New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets gives this permit.

title: Endangered and Threatened Species Licensing and Permitting
description: Businesses need special licenses to work with endangered species in New York State. This includes both dead and live animals.

title: Express Lane Permits
description: The Express Lane Permit is for ambulettes, commuter vans, shuttles, and other mass transit fleets. This permit allows these vehicles to use the high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lanes leading to the Queens Midtown and Brooklyn Battery Tunnels.

title: Fill Work Permit (Federal)
description: You need a Fill Work Permit to dump or place fill material in navigable waters. The New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) and the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (ACE) give these permits. You must send an application to both the ACE and DEC.

title: Food Service Establishment Permit
description: A food service establishment is a place where food is given to people, whether sold or free, and whether eaten on-site or taken away.

title: Green Cart Permit
description: New York City started the Green Cart Permit program. It helps people get fresh fruits and vegetables.

title: Group Child Care Center-Based Permit
description: A Group Child Care program provides care to three or more kids under six years old. The care is for five or more hours each week. It is also for more than 30 days in a year. The program usually runs in a place that is not a home.

title: Highway Work Permit for Non-Utility Work
description: If you need to work on a state-managed road and it does not involve utilities, you need a permit from the New York State Department of Transportation (NYSDOT).

title: Highway Work Permit for Utility Work
description: If you need to work on a state-managed road and utilities are involved, you need a permit from the New York State Department of Transportation (NYSDOT).

title: Hotel Beer Permit
description: This license lets hotels sell beer to customers. They can drink it on-site. The New York State Liquor Authority (SLA) gives the Hotel Beer License.

title: Hotel Liquor Permit
description: This license lets hotels sell alcoholic drinks to customers. Customers can drink these on-site. The New York State Liquor Authority (SLA) gives out this license.

title: Hotel Wine Permit
description: This license lets hotels sell wine or beer to customers. They can drink it on-site. The New York State Liquor Authority (SLA) gives the Hotel Wine License.

title: Industrial Homework, Permit to Distribute
description: Businesses need a permit to give workers industrial jobs to do at home. This permit is from the New York State Department of Labor (NYSDOL).

title: Industrial Wastewater Discharge Permit
description: Businesses that discharge industrial wastewater must follow the Sewer Use Regulations in Title 15 of the Rules of the City of New York (RCNY) Chapter 19.

title: Land Contour Permit
description: If you do land contour work in private or public property whose watershed contains public roadway or sidewalk, you need a Land Contour Permit from the Department of Transportation (DOT).

title: Liquidator's Permit
description: A Liquidator's Permit lets a closing business sell its products to other businesses. The New York State Liquor Authority (SLA) gives this permit.

title: Living Animals, Laboratory Permit for the Use of
description: Labs that use animals for research need a permit. This permit comes from the New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH). Labs must also follow all local, federal and other laws against cruelty to animals.

title: Marine Hatchery Permit
description: If you own, raise or breed marine life, you need a Marine Hatchery Permit to sell your products. This permit is from the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC). The permit covers fish and shellfish.

title: Mobile Food Vending Unit Permit (Full-Term)
description: You need a Mobile Food Vendor (MFV) permit to make and sell food from a cart or truck.

title: Non-Retail Food Processing Establishment Permit
description: You need a permit from the NYC Health Department to run a Non-Retail Food Processing Establishment in New York City that processes, prepares, stores or packs food. The food is not sold directly to people.

title: Non-Tobacco Hookah Establishment Permit
description: The Smoke-Free Air Act of 2002 says you cannot serve or smoke shisha containing tobacco in NYC restaurants and bars. An amendment to this law also bans serving or smoking non-tobacco shisha unless you have a permit.

title: OFTB Optional Permit
description: You do not need a permit from the Office of Film, Theatre and Broadcasting (OFTB) for all activities.

title: Permit to Install Sewer House Connection
description: A Permit to Install Single/Multiple Premises(s) Sewer House Connection lets you connect a new house sewer to a City or private sewer.

title: Permit to Manufacture and / or Wholesale Alcoholic Beverages
description: Businesses need a permit to make or wholesale alcohol in New York State. The New York State Liquor Authority (SLA) gives these permits.

title: Permit to Manufacture Frozen Desserts - Wholesale
description: Since January 20, 2012, the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene does not issue a permit for Manufacturing Frozen Desserts - Wholesale. This change is due to updates in the NYC Health Code.

title: Permit to Receive And/Or Process Milk and Milk Products (Part 2 Permit)
description: You need a Permit to Receive And/Or Process Milk and Milk Products to pasteurize milk or manufacture dairy products in New York State. This permit is also called a "Part 2 Permit." The New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets gives this permit.

title: Permit to Use a Hydrant
description: â˜' Approved by SBS/OTI

title: Permits for Movie Premieres and Screenings
description: The Office of Film, Theatre and Broadcasting (OFTB) gives permits. These permits are for red carpet, film, TV and theatre events. The events must be on public property. This includes City streets, sidewalks or parks.

title: Pesticide Commercial (Sale of Restricted Pesticides) Permit
description: You need a Commercial Pesticide Permit to sell or distribute restricted pesticides. The New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) issues this permit.

title: Pesticide Use of Chemicals for the Control or Elimination of Aquatic Insects Permit
description: This permit lets you use chemicals to control or get rid of biting aquatic insects. These insects include mosquitoes and black flies. You need this permit to use chemicals in any waters in New York State. The State Department of Environmental Conservation gives out this permit.

title: Pesticide Use of Chemicals for the Control or Elimination of Aquatic Vegetation Permit
description: This permit lets you use chemicals to control or remove aquatic vegetation in New York State. The State Department of Environmental Conservation gives this permit.

title: Regulated Medical Waste (RMW) Facility Permit
description: Businesses need a permit to build a regulated medical waste (RMW) facility. This permit comes from the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC).

title: Required Motion Picture & Television Permit
description: This permit lets you film in public locations and park production vehicles in public places. You can use it in 300 square miles of public settings in the City. This includes 27,000 acres of City parks.

title: Restricted Area Mobile Food Vending Permit
description: This permit lets you sell food from a mobile unit on private property. The property must be in a commercially zoned area. You can also sell food on property under the jurisdiction of the NYC Department of Parks & Recreation. This permit is exempt from the statutory limits which apply to public street vending.

title: Scavenger Waste Permits
description: If your business will transport scavenger waste that will need to be discharged into the New York City sewer system, you need a Scavenger Waste Discharge Permit from the New York City Department of Environmental Protection (DEP).

title: Shelter for Homeless Animals Permit
description: An Animal Shelter or Shelter for Homeless Animals is a place for homeless, stray, abandoned or unwanted animals. These animals are received, harbored, maintained, made available for adoption, returned to their owners or disposed of in other lawful ways.

title: Shows, Permit to Operate
description: This permit lets a promoter run events like:

title: Sidewalk and Roadways Construction Permits (general)
description: A licensed professional, like a contractor or engineer, usually handles this permit. Property owners are required to maintain sidewalks, or provide sidewalks in the case of new construction, for public use.

title: Sidewalk Crossing Permit
description: You need a permit from the Department of Transportation (DOT) to drive a vehicle or motorized equipment across a sidewalk without an approved driveway or dropped curb cut. This is needed to deliver or remove construction material or equipment.

title: Small Animal Boarding Establishment Permit
description: A small animal boarding place is where animals stay for a fee. This includes places where animals are sheltered, harbored, maintained, groomed, fed or given water. If you run such an establishment, you need a permit from the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH).

title: Small Animal Grooming Establishment Permit
description: A place where owners bring their pets for bathing, dipping, clipping, combing or cleaning for the purpose of improvement of the animal's appearance and/or wellbeing for a fee needs a permit. This permit is from the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH).

title: Small Animal Training Establishment Permit
description: If you train small animals for money, you need a permit from the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH).

title: Special Event Permit
description: Businesses need a Special Event Permit to sell alcohol in ways not covered by their license. These include:

title: Special Hauling Permit
description: Big vehicles need a Special Hauling Permit to drive on the New York State Thruway. You must get the permit before using the Thruway.

title: Special Hauling Trip and Annual Oversize/Overweight Loads Permit
description: You need a Special Hauling Permit to move very heavy items. This permit comes from the New York State Department of Transportation (NYSDOT).

title: Special Theatrical Rifle / Shotgun Permit
description: You need a Special Theatrical Rifle / Shotgun Permit to use rifles or shotguns in TV, movie, stage, theater or similar productions. Professional photographers also need this permit for photo sessions.

title: Street Activity Permit
description: The Street Activity Permit Office (SAPO) in New York City gives permits for events. These events include:

title: Street Tree Planting Permit
description: To plant a tree in New York City, you need a Tree Planting Permit. You also need to hire a landscape contractor.

title: Tandem Trailer Permit
description: This permit lets you drive long combination vehicles (LCV) on the New York State Thruway. These vehicles are also called "tandem trailers."

title: Tanning Indoor Facility Permit
description: You need a permit to run a place where ultraviolet (UV) radiation devices (tanning machines) are used, offered or made available for use and for which a fee is charged either directly or indirectly. This rule is from the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DoHMH).

title: Temporary Food Service Establishment Permit
description: You need a permit to make and serve food at a temporary special event. This includes food from booths, stands, kiosks, vehicles or carts.

title: Temporary Residence, Permit to Operate
description: If you run a hotel, motel, guesthouse or any place that gives shelter to more than 10 people for over 60 hours a year, you need a Permit to Operate a Temporary Residence.

title: Temporary Street Fair Vendor Permit
description: As of August 30, 2024, you do not need a temporary vendor permit from the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) to be a street fair vendor.

title: Tree Work Permit
description: You need a Tree Work Permit to work on or within 50 feet of a street tree. This rule is for everyone. It includes people, businesses and contractors. It applies to trees on New York City property.

title: Warehouse Permit
description: The New York State Liquor Authority (SLA) gives out Warehouse Permits. These permits let businesses store alcohol in a different place from where they sell it. To get a Warehouse Permit, you need:

title: Waste Transporter Permit
description: A Waste Transporter Permit lets a business move waste by vehicle in New York State. The State Environmental Conservation Department gives this permit.

title: Waterfront Construction Work Permits
description: You need a permit to build or fix any structure on City-owned waterfront property. This includes:

title: Well Water Permit
description: You need a permit from the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene to install, drill, replace or use a water well in New York City. This includes water well pumps and well pumping equipment. The permit is for both potable (drinking) and non-potable (not for drinking) wells. You can use one application for both.

title: Wetlands Permit
description: You need a Wetlands Permit to build, dredge or clear land in or near wetlands. The New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) gives this permit.

title: Wine and/or Liquor Auction Permit
description: This permit lets businesses hold up to 12 wine or liquor auctions each year. The New York State Liquor Authority (SLA) gives this permit.

title: Air Facility Registration
description: Businesses that release pollutants into the air need permits from the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC). If your business emits low levels of pollutants, you must register as an Air Facility.

title: Alcohol Dealer Registration
description: All stores, restaurants and bars that sell beer, wine or liquor must register with the United States Department of the Treasury's Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau.

title: Apple Storage (Controlled Atmosphere Refrigerated Facility Registration)
description: In New York State, apples labeled "controlled atmosphere" must be stored in special conditions. These rules come from the New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets.

title: Athlete Agent Registration
description: If you want to recruit student athletes, you must register with the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Beekeeper Registration
description: â˜' Approved by agency

title: Chain Store (Cigarette) Registration
description: Chain stores that sell cigarettes can register with the New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (DTF). Registering lets stores sell cigarettes at lower prices.

title: Cigarette and Tobacco Product Sales as a Retail Dealer Registration
description: If you sell cigarettes, you must register your business with the New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (DTF).

title: Cigarette and Tobacco Product Sales Vending Machine Registration
description: If your business sells cigarettes through vending machines, you must register with the New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (DTF). Each machine needs its own registration. You must register every year.

title: Collateral Loan Broker's Registration Statement
description: Collateral loan brokers, also known as pawn shops, must register with the New York State Comptroller.

title: Commercial Vehicle Registration
description: If you use a vehicle for business, you need to register it in New York State with the New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV).

title: Controlled Substances Registration
description: Businesses that handle controlled substances must register with the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA). Controlled substances include drugs and medicines for treating animals or humans.

title: Cooling Tower Registration
description: Building owners and property managers must register cooling towers, fluid coolers and evaporative condensers with the City. If you have any of this equipment, you need to register through the NYC Health Department at Cooling Tower Registration. This is required by Local Law 77 of 2015, effective August 18, 2015.

title: Dealer Registration - Motor Vehicles, Motorcycles or Trailers, Official Business Certificate
description: This registration lets a business buy, sell or deal motor vehicles, motorcycles or trailers over 1,000 pounds. Businesses must register with the New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV).

title: Deposit Initiator Registration (Bottle Deposits)
description: In New York State, businesses that sell bottled drinks must collect a $0.05 deposit on each bottle. The New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (DTF) enforces this rule.

title: Drugs or Devices Wholesaler Registration
description: If you want to sell drugs or medical devices in New York State, you need to register with New York State. Medical devices include things like:

title: Electronic Cigarette Retail Store Registration
description: All stores that sell electronic cigarettes must register with the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH). This is required by the Smoke Free Air Act. Once you register, you can sell electronic cigarettes in your store. You only need to register one time. There is no fee to register.

title: Family Day Care Registration
description: Family Day Care offers child care in a family home. This care is for more than three hours per day per child. It can include:

title: Fleet Registration
description: If you run a business with big trucks or other large commercial vehicles (that is, weighing over 10,000 pounds), you need to register them with the U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT).

title: Fund Raising Professional Registration
description: If you raise money for charities and get paid for it, you need to register with the New York State Attorney General.

title: Guard Dog Registration
description: You need to register all guard or attack dogs. This is for both businesses and individuals. Guard dogs are trained to:

title: Halal Certifiers and Products Certified Registration
description: If you run a business that makes or sells Halal food, you need to register with the New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets.

title: Hearing Aid Business Registration
description: If you sell hearing aids or hearing aid services, you must register with the New York State Department of State.

title: Itinerant Vehicle Collector, Official Business Registration
description: If you buy and sell unusable vehicles for scrap, you must register with the New York State DMV.

title: Kosher Food Registration
description: If you have a business that makes or sells kosher food, you need to register with the New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets.

title: Limited Liability Partnership (Foreign), Notice of Registration
description: Limited liability partnerships (LLPs) from outside New York State can register with the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Limited Service Laboratory Registration
description: Labs that only do certain clinical tests can register as Limited Service Laboratories. They register with the New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH).

title: Market Business Registration
description: You need Market Business Registration if you provide goods or services to wholesalers or retail purchasers at a New York City public wholesale market. A market business includes services like security within a market. Market Business Registrations expire every three years.

title: Mobile Lasers and Laser Installation, Registration of
description: You must register all high- and low-intensity lasers with the New York State Department of Labor. A certified person must make sure the lasers are safe.

title: Money Services Business Registration
description: Money services businesses (MSBs) must register with the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN). FinCEN is part of the U.S. Treasury Department.

title: Mortgage Banker Branch Registration
description: If a business wants to offer loans as a mortgage banker, it must register with the New York State Department of Financial Services (DFS).

title: Mortgage Broker Registration
description: If you work with mortgage loans in New York, you need to register with the New York State Department of Financial Services (DFS). This rule is for businesses that:

title: Newsrack Registration Form
description: The Department of Transportation (DOT) manages newsracks on City sidewalks. A newsrack is a box where you can get newspapers or other written material. These boxes can be self-service or coin-operated. If you own a newsrack, you must register it with DOT before placing it on the sidewalk.

title: Pesticide Business and Agency Registration
description: Businesses that use pesticides must register with the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC).

title: Pet Food and Specialty Pet Food Registration
description: If you make or sell pet food in New York State, you need to register each brand or type. This helps keep pets, people and the pet industry safe. It also makes sure labels are correct and complete.

title: Petroleum Bulk Storage Registration
description: Businesses that store petroleum or petroleum products must register with the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC).

title: Pharmacy Registration
description: Pharmacies must register with the New York State Education Department (NYSED). This must happen before a pharmacy can give out drugs and devices.

title: Professional Employer Organization Registration
description: You must register your professional employer organization with the New York State Department of Labor (NYSDOL).

title: Registration for Demolition Form AR299/300
description: If you want to demolish a building, structure, facility or installation, you must fill out the Registration for Demolition Form AR 299/300. You need to send it to the New York City Department of Environmental Protection (DEP). Do this 10 days before you start the demolition.

title: Registration for Funeral Directors in NYC
description: Funeral directors in New York City need a license from the New York State Bureau of Funeral Directing. They also need to register with the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH), Office of Vital Records, Burial Desk.

title: Registration for the removal of Construction and Demolition Debris (C&D Registration)
description: You need a Class 2 Registration to remove only waste from building demolition, construction, alteration or excavation. This registration is also called an Exemption from Licensing Requirements. The registration expires every two years from the date of approval.

title: Retailer of Non-Highway Diesel Motor Fuel
description: If you sell diesel fuel for off-road use in New York State, you must register with the New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (DTF).

title: Salvage Pool, Official Business Registration
description: If you sell junk cars or big car parts, you must register. You need to sign up with the New York State DMV.

title: School Age Child Care Registration
description: School-age Child Care programs offer childcare in a non-residential location. These programs care for seven or more children under 13 years old. They run during the school year such as before and after school, during lunch periods and on school holidays. They also may run when schools are not in session, like in the summer. Children in kindergarten or higher grades can join.

title: School-Based Child Care Certificate (Notice of Filing)
description: A School-Based Child Care (SBCC) program provides care for more than six children who are 3-5 years old. These programs are in a City school or are otherwise affiliated with a school.

title: Security Guard Registration
description: To be a security guard in New York State, you must register with the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS). This is for both armed and unarmed security guards.

title: Self Hauler Registration
description: You need a Class 1 Self Hauler Registration if you or your business removes its own waste. This does not include construction and demolition debris.

title: Smoke Free Air Act Exemption - Register a Tobacco Event
description: You need to register a tobacco promotion event with the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH). A tobacco promotion event is where people can sample and promote tobacco products. Food and drinks may also be served.

title: Smoke Free Air Act Exemption Registration - Membership Organizations
description: Membership organizations that want to be exempt from the 2002 Smoke Free Air Act must apply to register with the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH).

title: Snowmobile Dealer Registration
description: This registration lets you sell snowmobiles. You can sell them at wholesale or retail. A snowmobile is a vehicle with tracks for travels over snow in winter conditions.

title: Surety Bond Registration
description: Surety bonds help make sure projects get done. The Bureau of the Fiscal Service (BFS) handles surety bonds across the country. The BFS is part of the Department of the Treasury. Companies must apply to the BFS if they want to:

title: Telemarketer Registration
description: If you run a telemarketing business in New York, you must register with the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS). Your employees do not need to register.

title: Ticket Distributor Registration, Original
description: Ticket distributors at entertainment places must sign up with the New York State Attorney General's Office. This rule is only for for-profit businesses.

title: Tobacco Retail Store Registration
description: All stores that sell tobacco must register with the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH). This is a rule from the Smoke Free Air Act. After you register, you can allow smoking on your premises. You only need to register once and there is no fee.

title: Trade Waste Broker Registration
description: You need a Class 2 Trade Waste Broker Registration if you help people in New York City find waste services for a fee. This includes businesses that evaluate or analyze waste and suggest cost-efficient ways to get rid of it. The registration lasts for two years.

title: Vehicle Dismantler, Official Business Registration
description: If you take apart vehicles, you must register with the New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV).

title: Water Well Contractor Registration
description: In New York State, businesses must register every year to drill water wells. They do this with the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC).

title: Wholesale Business Registration
description: You need a Wholesale Business Registration to sell in a New York City public wholesale market. This is for businesses that sell food or related agricultural/horticultural products at wholesale prices. These products are for other businesses to resell. The registration lasts for three years.

title: X-Ray Machines and Particle Accelerators for Non-Human Use, Registration of
description: Businesses that use machines with radiation need a safety expert. They must also register their equipment with New York City and State.

title: Adult Care Facility - Assisted Living Program
description: Assisted living programs in New York State must have a Certificate of Need to operate. This certificate comes from the New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH).

title: Adult Care Facility - Enriched Housing Program
description: Enriched housing programs need a special certificate to operate in New York State. This certificate comes from the New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH).

title: Application for Approval of Backflow Prevention Devices
description: If you own a property, you need a backflow prevention device on every water service pipe that connects the drinking water supply and a possible source of contamination. This device stops dirty water from mixing with clean water. A licensed plumber or engineer can help you decide whether you need this device.

title: Bikes in Buildings Program
description: The Bikes in Buildings program helps people who work in office buildings. If your building was built before November 18, 2009, and has at least one freight elevator, your employer can ask the building owner to let employees bring their bicycles inside.

title: Buildings Information System
description: The Buildings Information System (BISWeb) is the main database for the Department of Buildings (DOB). It gives real-time data to anyone with internet access.

title: Garbage and Recycling Collection for Professionals - Professional Fee Program
description: The New York City (NYC) Department of Sanitation has a program. It helps licensed professionals like doctors, accountants and lawyers. This program is for garbage and recycling collection for those working in a residential building.

title: Grease Interceptor Information
description: If you run a business that produces and disposes of fat, oil or grease (FOGs), like a restaurant, food processing establishment, hospital or day care and senior center, you need a grease interceptor. This system stops FOGs from clogging the city's sewer lines. It separates FOGs from wastewater.

title: Health Insurance
description: Health insurance helps you pay for health care. You can get health insurance from:

title: Immigration Assistance Services Requirements
description: People or businesses that help with immigration law for money must follow New York State Law.

title: Information About Construction Projects that Last More Than Three Months
description: The Office of Construction Mitigation and Coordination (OCMC) requires any large construction projects that last more than three months to put up informational signs at the site.

title: Information About Fire Alarms
description: If you have a Certificate of Fitness (C of F) for Supervision of Fire Alarm Systems, you need to be at any building where a fire alarm system is installed.

title: Information About Impacting Trees
description: If you want to remove, perform work on or perform any work within 50 feet of a street tree, you need a permit. Some examples of work are:

title: Information About Landmarks
description: A landmark is a special building, property or object with historical or artistic value. The Landmarks Preservation Commission (LPC) designates these landmarks.

title: Information About Occupying, Repairing, Or Replacing Sidewalks, Roadways, or Curbs
description: In New York City, property owners must take care of the sidewalk next to their property, including the intersection corner quadrant, at their own cost.

title: Information About Pest Control
description: The City Health Department wants all businesses in New York City to prevent pest infestations. Pests can spread to other places and negatively impact the quality of life in a neighborhood. Building owners and tenants must prevent or address pest infestations on a property. Help is available for business owners to stop and get rid of pests.

title: Information About Sprinklers
description: All buildings with sprinklers must follow New York City Fire Department (FDNY) regulations. This includes buildings that will have a sprinkler system installed.

title: Information About Sprinklers, Fire Alarms, and Standpipes
description: Buildings need fire alarms, fire suppression systems or standpipes. The type depends on the building's use or the construction code.

title: Information About Standpipes
description: Standpipes give firefighters water access inside a building.

title: Information About Water and Sewer Requirements
description: Businesses in New York City must pay for water and sewer services. These services come from the Department of Environmental Protection (DEP). This includes:

title: Information for Use, Storage and Transfer of Explosives
description: The New York City Fire Department (FDNY) makes sure explosives are properly handled, stored, used and transported to keep everyone safe.

title: Language Translation, Interpretation, and Apostille Information
description: Certified documents must meet state and federal rules to be valid. This rule applies to translations, notarizations, authentications and apostilles. This page explains how to get these documents for business use in New York State.

title: NYC Parks Request for Bid (RFB): Pushcart, Mobile Food Unit or Food Cart
description: This guide helps you get a permit to run a mobile food unit in NYC parks. This includes:

title: NYC Parks Request for Proposal (RFP)
description: Requests for proposals (RFPs) are issued for a variety of NYC Parks concessions. These include snack bars, restaurants, golf courses, ice rinks, tennis facilities, stables and marinas.

title: Oil and Water Separators
description: Oil and water separators are important for places like:

title: Revocable Consent Petition
description: If you intend to install a structure on, under, or over a City street or sidewalk, you must petition for a revocable consent.

title: Sand Interceptors
description: Sand interceptors are needed at car and vehicle washes. They stop sand, grit, rocks and dirt from going into the sewer system. Car and vehicle washes make a lot of this waste. Without sand interceptors, the sewer system would receive unacceptable amounts of pollutants.

title: Street Cleaning Information for Film Productions
description: The New York City Department of Sanitation (DSNY) cleans streets for film productions. You can ask for cleaning before and after filming. There is a fee for this service.

title: Surety Bonds for Contractors
description: A surety bond makes sure a contract gets completed if a contractor defaults. If a contractor can't finish a project, the surety company will find another contractor. If they can't, the client gets compensation for the loss.

title: Accepting Electronic Signatures
description: In New York State, electronic signatures are equal to paper signatures. This is because of the Electronics Signatures and Records Act (ESRA). All businesses must follow this law.

title: Adult Care Facility - Adult Home
description: Adult homes and care facilities need a Certificate of Need to operate in New York State. This certificate must be filed with the New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH).

title: Adult Care Facility - Residence for Adults
description: In New York State, homes that care for adults need a special certificate. This certificate is from the New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH).

title: Air Code
description: The goal of the New York City Air Pollution Control Code (Air Code) is to keep the air clean and safe. The City wants everyone to have air that is not harmful to life, health or enjoyment of their property.

title: ARCS Commissioning Test Report
description: The 2014 New York City Building Code states that new high-rise buildings need an Auxiliary Radio Communication (ARC) system. This system is only used by the New York City Fire Department (FDNY) to help them talk inside a building using radios.

title: Asbestos Rules and Regulations
description: If you need to remove or handle asbestos, you must follow the federal, state and city rules. You must tell the New York City Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) at least seven days before you start.

title: ATM Owner / Operator Requirements
description: If you own or run automated teller machines (ATMs), you must follow certain laws enforced by the New York State Department of Financial Services (DFS).

title: Automotive Battery Collection and Recycling
description: If you sell new lead-acid car batteries, you must accept old ones for recycling. This rule applies to stores and distributors.

title: Auxiliary Radio Communication System Application
description: An auxiliary radio communication system (ARCS) is a wireless two-way building communication system. It is for New York City Fire Department (FDNY) use only. It helps firefighters talk inside a building.

title: Best Management Practices Plans (BMPPs) for Persons Discharging Total Silver Halide Process Wastewater to the Public Sewer System
description: If you or your business sends total silver halide process wastewater to the public sewer system, you must follow the rules. These rules are in Title 15 of the Rules of the City of New York (RCNY) Section 19-07. This wastewater comes from any silver halide imaging process.

title: Best Management Practices to Reduce Stormwater Pollution
description: Best Management Practices (BMPs) to reduce stormwater pollution help keep NYC water clean. They are part of a plan to stop dirty rainwater from getting into the city sewers from places that work on cars, including:

title: Body Piercing and Tattooing Guidelines
description: The New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH) makes rules for tattooing and body piercing.

title: Brand Label Registration
description: If you make and sell alcoholic drinks in New York State, you need to register your brand labels with the State Liquor Authority (SLA). This rule makes sure all drinks are safe to drink and meet labeling requirements.

title: Bureau of Fire Prevention Documents/Forms
description: The New York City Fire Department (FDNY) checks and controls the installation of equipment.

title: Business Owner Bill of Rights
description: As part of New York City's commitment to provide New Yorkers with excellent customer service, the Mayor's Office and the City Council created a Business Owner's Bill of Rights.

title: Calorie Posting
description: New York City has rules for restaurants to post calorie information. If a restaurant has 15 or more locations with the same name or owner, they must show calorie information on their menus and menu boards. This rule applies if the food is made the same way and in the same size.

title: Cell Phone Collection and Recycling
description: In New York State, any business that sells cell phones or cell phone plans must take old phones for recycling. They must accept all types of cell phones and must take up to 10 phones a year from each person.

title: Chemical or Oil Spill Reporting Requirement
description: By law, you must report chemical or petroleum (gas or oil) spills to the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC).

title: Clothing Rental/Sale Regulations
description: If your business sells or rents clothes, you must follow hygiene and safety rules set by the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Commercial Bicyclist Regulations
description: Do you run a business that uses bicycles? Do you hire people to ride bikes for work? If yes, you must follow the rules in Sections 10-157 and 10-157.1 of the New York City Administrative Code and in Section 4-08(p) of the Rules of the City of New York.

title: Commercial Vehicle Parking Information
description: You need to pay to park a commercial vehicle in the City. Look for metered "No Standing Commercial Vehicles Only" zones. These rules are in effect Monday through Friday from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. unless a sign says otherwise.

title: Commercial Vehicle Restrictions
description: This guide will help you learn the rules for commercial vehicles and trucks in New York City. You can find more details in Chapter 4 of the Rules of the City of New York.

title: Comprehensive Fire Safety and Emergency Action Plan
description: City Fire Department

title: Concept Proposal Tech Document
description: City Fire Department

title: Construction Industry Fair Play Act
description: The Fair Play Act protects anyone who works for a construction business. This law makes sure businesses give workers their rights.

title: Construction Noise Mitigation Plan
description: Construction sites must post a Construction Noise Plan. This plan should be complete and correct. It must be visible at the site all the time.

title: Construction Noise Regulations
description: The Construction Noise Regulation is part of the Noise Code in New York City. It is in Title 15 Rules of the City of New York (RCNY) Chapter 28. The Noise Code sets policies and standards for managing noise in the City. The Construction Noise Regulation includes extra strategies, methods, procedures and technology to reduce noise at construction sites. These steps help lessen the noise impact in areas where construction happens.

title: Consumer Protection Law
description: The New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) can make rules to stop practices it sees as deceptive or unfair under the Consumer Protection Law (CPL). The New York City Consumer Protection Law stops all "deceptive or unfair trade practices." This covers selling, leasing, renting or loaning any consumer goods and services and collecting consumer debts.

title: Corporation (Foreign), Application for Authority
description: If your business is from another state and wants to operate in New York, you might need a Certificate of Authority from the New York State Department of State (NYSDOS).

title: Doctor and / or Dentist Office
description: Doctor and dentist offices must follow rules from the New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH). These rules include:

title: Dry Cleaning, Regulations on Perchloroethylene (Perc)
description: In New York State, dry cleaners must follow rules about a chemical called perchloroethylene, or "perc." The New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) makes sure these rules are followed.

title: E-Laws Employment Law Assistance for Workers and Small Businesses
description: The U.S. Department of Labor provides support to employers and workers about federal labor laws through online tools.

title: Election by a Small Business Corporation
description: A small business can avoid double taxation by becoming an "S corporation."

title: Electronic Equipment Recycling and Reuse Act
description: If your business sells or makes electronic devices, it must recycle electronic waste. You must tell customers how to collect and recycle this waste. Businesses cannot sell devices from companies without a recycling system. You must send yearly reports to the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) through the E-Waste Online Registration and Reporting System.

title: Employee Disability Coverage
description: In New York State, employers must give disability benefits to workers. This is for injuries or illnesses that happen off the job.

title: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
description: Businesses need an Employer Identification Number (EIN) issued by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS).

title: Engineering Application and Amendment
description: Engineering applications and amendments are for installing new technology; changing existing technology; storing, manufacturing or selling flammable materials; and getting permits defined by FC 105.1

title: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission
description: The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) enforces federal laws against discrimination.

title: Facility Inventory Form FIF - Community Right-to-Know Program
description: If your facility holds a hazardous substance at an amount at or above the threshold set by City regulations during the year, you must fill out a Facility Inventory Form. You also need to pay the fees. Some facilities must also send a risk management plan to the Department of Environmental Protection by March 1 every year.

title: Fire Alarm Application
description: A fire alarm keeps people safe by detecting smoke, fire or carbon monoxide. When it does, it warns people and calls the Fire Department.

title: Fire Alarm Variance
description: The City Fire Department needs fire alarm systems and auxiliary radio communication systems (ARCS) in buildings. These systems must follow the NYC Building Code, NYC Electrical Code, and NFPA 72 standard.

title: Fire Code Modification (Variance)
description: Use Form BFP-MOD to ask the Fire Department for a change (variance) to any Fire Code or Fire Department Rule. This follows NYC Fire Code Section FC 104.8 and 3RCNY §104-01.

title: Fire Protection Plan
description: A fire protection plan is a document you give to the Fire Department of New York (FDNY). It shows that your building has fire safety and evacuation systems. These systems must follow the rules in Article 109 of the NYC Construction Codes.

title: Fire Safety and Evacuation Plans
description: Fire Safety and Evacuation Plans help people leave a building safely during a fire. These plans also help firefighters understand the building. They show the building's layout, exits, fire hazards and important contacts.

title: Gas Authorization for Restaurants
description: If you need to change, move or remove any gas pipes for your restaurant's cooking equipment, a Licensed Master Plumber must do the work. For range-hood (Ansul) systems, a Licensed Master Fire Suppression Piping Contractor must install and test them with an FDNY inspector.

title: Gasoline Transport Vehicles Requirements
description: If you own or operate a vehicle that delivers gasoline to any gasoline dispensing site in New York City, you need a stage 1 vapor collection system. This system moves gasoline vapors from a tank into a vapor-tight holding system or an equivalent system. This rule applies to vehicles moving gasoline to or from any gasoline loading terminal or bulk plant.

title: HACCP Certification
description: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) is a food safety risk management system. It stops food safety problems before they happen.
